data:
寒灾的存在本身就是一种警告：如果再不为了生命而战，就将如它一般迎来终结。
<@rolv.rem>场地中有喷出气流的<源石流发生装置></>

命のために戦わぬ限り、必ず終末が訪れる――寒災の存在は、それを示すある種の警告だ。
<@rolv.rem>戦場に気流を生み出す<源石気流発生装置>が出現。</>

The existence of 'Frozen Monstrosities' is itself a warning: If you don't fight for your life, you will end up just like it.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Jetstreams> that generate airflow currents are present on the field</>
寒灾初始无敌时长改为40s
Frozen Monstrosity's initial invincible duration changed to 40s
所有敌方单位的攻击力+20%，生命值+40%，法术抗性+30
雪怪术师与雪怪术师组长的攻击范围+100%
敵全員の攻撃力+20%、最大HP+40%、術耐性+30
<スノーキャスター>と<スノーキャスター隊長>の攻撃範囲+100%
All enemy units have +20% ATK, +40% Max HP and +30 RES
<Yeti Caster> and <Yeti Caster Leader> have +100% Attack range
枯朽サルカズ戦士隊長
スノーキャスター隊長
枯朽サルカズ精鋭戦車

Blows out an airflow towards the 3 frontal tiles; Operators deployed <@ba.vup>downstream</>/<@ba.vdown>upstream</> from the airflow have <@ba.vup>increased</>/<@ba.vdown>decreased</> ATK; Enemies moving <@ba.vdown>downstream</>/<@ba.vup>upstream</> from the airflow have <@ba.vdown>increased</>/<@ba.vup>decreased</> Movement Speed
More likely to be attacked by enemies
Reflect some damage taken, gives +4 Originium Ingots when defeated
